info.title: AML Text-to-SQL Model Service
info.description: Internal-only API that turns a natural-language question into SQL: retrieves relevant tables from the knowledge graph, serializes them as DDL, prompts the model, and schema-validates the result. Not intended to be called directly by end users -- aml-analytics-service is the public product surface that calls this.

tags.name: Generation
tags.description: SQL generation from a natural-language question.

stage.description: "kg_repair" (retrieval-scoped) or omitted for the canonical schema validator

question.description: Natural-language question about the AML dataset.

with_system_prompt.description: Prepend the business-analyst/read-only-SQL system prompt to the model input.

top_k.description: Number of tables the retrieval engine selects before hop expansion.

use_exemplars.description: Reuse a verified answer for (near-)duplicate known KPI questions instead of regenerating.

ground_tables.description: Prepend a dynamic 'use only these exact table names' line.

retry_on_invalid.description: If the first attempt fails schema validation, widen retrieval and regenerate once with the violations fed back into the prompt.

execution_mode.description: Used by aml-analytics-service: emits native BigQuery types/enums directly, skipping exemplar answers and fuzzy repair.

allowed_columns.description: Table -> allowed column names, used with execution_mode to scope generation to the caller's authorized resources.

ollama_ready.description: Whether the primary local model backend is reachable right now.

generation_ready.description: Whether POST /generate-sql can currently service a request at all, across every configured generation path.

post.summary: Generate SQL from a natural-language question

503.description: Generation unavailable; check the model service's own logs.
